Those that fight for the Alliance, fight for freedom, and the promise of a life without tyranny. They fight harder, gaining +20% durability. Armor-Piercing, Multi-Role, Astromech

With an excellent mix of durability and firepower, the Incom built T-65 X-wing is as reliable as it is versatile. Built as a general-purpose starfighter the X-wing can engage both lighter craft and larger, more heavily armored gunships and while it has an average top speed, the X-Wings S-foils can help it flee from engagements it cannot win. Its astromech droid can make repairs while it is engaged in combat, benefitting from prolonged dogfighting against craft with low damage output, or craft with debuffed firerate. While the T-65 is an excellent general-purpose craft, it can be outmaneuvered and will struggle in dogfights against dedicated agile, high-damage dogfighters like the Imperial TIE Interceptor, where its self-repair and shielding are overwhelmed. Indeed, for many later Imperial interceptor craft being able to hunt and destroy the versatile X-wing became a design necessity, and later designs such as the Avenger and Hunter will mercilessly beat the X-wing. The X-wing can be used against a variety of targets, but should avoid dedicated dogfighters, or using single, head-on strikes to benefit from its durability when necessary.

Those that fight for the Alliance, fight for freedom, and the promise of a life without tyranny. They fight harder, gaining +20% durability. Large Unit, Anti-Large, Ion Torpedo, Terrible Dogfighter, Armor-Piercing, Astromech, High Capacity Shielding

Also dubbed the workhorse of the Rebellion, the BTL Y-wing is a durable, reliable, and versatile craft. Strong shielding protects the Y-Wings heavily armored chassis, and an astromech aids in onboard repairs. The Y-wing is best used against slow and bulky craft such as gunships, or to bomb starships, where its ion torpedoes can drain starship systems power. Due to its sheer durability and turreted ion cannon that lowers the firerate on hostile starfighters, the Y-wing can often deal with light resistance such as basic TIEs on its own. Dispite its versatility the Y-Wing is an easy target, suffering from low maneuverability and a large target profile.

The new standard Headhunter model is equipped with Concussion Missiles, making the Z-95 more effective than it should be at supporting friendly fighters against hostile starfighters, severely debuffing their firepower thereby allowing friendly craft to more cost-effectively deal with them. On its own, the standard Headhunter is not very good at anything but be annoying thanks to its debuff.

Those that fight for the Alliance, fight for freedom, and the promise of a life without tyranny. They fight harder, gaining +20% durability. Small Target, Anti-Light, Dogfighter, Passive Jamming, Interceptor Shielding, Advanced Engines

Designed after the Battle of Yavin was almost lost to a trio of nimble TIE fighters during the Trench Run, the RZ-1 A-wing is a fast, nimble and very capable dogfighter with deceptively few weapons that outperforms most interceptor craft. Especially deadly to lightly armored craft, the A-wings light lasers provide a short burst of highly accurate laser fire from its swiveling laser mounts, capable of rotating vertically 360 degrees, allowing for consistent firing even at targets chasing it. Combined with the crippling debuff from its Concussion Missiles the A-wing can ruin far more imposing starfighters as it strips them of their firepower, presenting only a small target that moves quickly and fires constantly, protected by a small built-in guidance jammer and rapidly-recharging Interceptor shields. Best used to chase down and dogfight with light or medium armored foes, or debuff heavily armored craft leaving them vulnerable to starfighters with more firepower. Dispite its ability to dodge enemy fire, the A-wing has only light hull integrity and is vulnerable against heavily armed, high performance interceptors like the TIE Avenger.

Armor: Medium 2x Swiveling Light Laser, 1x Concussion Missile Agility: 2.55 Max Speed: 4.0 SP: 20(4.5/s) HP: 30 6 Models per squadron.

Those that fight for the Alliance, fight for freedom, and the promise of a life without tyranny. They fight harder, gaining +20% durability. Large Unit, Anti-Large, Ion Torpedo, Terrible Dogfighter, Heavily armed, High Capacity Shielding

Designed out of need for a heavy assault starfighter to destroy escort ships more quickly than the Y-wing, the A/SF-01 B-wing is more heavily armed and is equipped with modular hardpoints. The B-wing has a devastating forward barrage of ion and laser fire supported by advanced proton torpedoes. It is able to shred the shields of any starfighter and gunship if it can engage them head-on, and its ion torpedoes debuff frigates and capital ships. Best used as damage dealers against both gunships and starships, shredding shields, incapacitating enemy capital ships and obliterating heavily armored targets. Dispite its devastating forward firepower the B-Wing is an easy target, suffering from low maneuverability and a large target profile. It also lacks a astromech droid for onboard repairs.

Armor: Heavy 3x Ion Cannon, 2x Light Laser, 1x Heavy Laser, 2x Advanced Proton Torpedo, 1x Ion Torpedo Agility: 1.275 Max Speed: 2.5 SP: 65(3/s) HP: 55 6 Models per squadron.

Those that fight for the Alliance, fight for freedom, and the promise of a life without tyranny. They fight harder, gaining +20% durability. Large Unit, Anti-Large, Ion Torpedo, Terrible Dogfighter, Heavily armed, High Capacity Shielding

Making use of the modular hardpoints the B-wing can be equipped with a variety of weapons. The A/SF-02 sees its 3 ion cannons replaced with 3 light turbolasers. This significantly increases its damage to unshielded starships but strips the B-wing of its versatility by making it significantly worse against starfighters and other small targets that its turbolasers are not accurate enough to hit, reliably or at all. The removal of the ion cannons also means the B-wing can no longer debuff the firepower of hit starfighters, further increasing its vulnerability to hostile fighters and bombers. Best used as heavy damage dealer against unshielded starships, incapacitating enemy capital ships and obliterating heavily armored targets. Dispite its devastating forward firepower the B-Wing is an easy target, suffering from low maneuverability and a large target profile. It also lacks a astromech droid for onboard repairs.

Those that fight for the Alliance, fight for freedom, and the promise of a life without tyranny. They fight harder, gaining +20% durability. Armor-Piercing, Advanced Armor, Multi-Role, Astromech

The first fighter designed by the New Republic, the E-7 E-wing is designed to match and exceed the performance of the iconic, Incom designed T-65 X-wing in every way, intending to eventually replace the older craft with a similar general-purpose starfighter. While suffering several performance drawbacks and technical difficulties, these updated models prove just as reliable and perform better than the older starfighter they're designed to succeed, even sporting heavy armor uncommon in such relatively small and nimble craft. The E-Wing is used much like the X-Wing, just to better effect, even incorporating flares to act as temporary countermeassures and a Redirect Power to Engines ability to stand in for the iconic S-Foils. While the E-7 is a powerful general-purpose craft, it remains vulnerable to high performance interceptors, much like its predecessor.

Those that fight for the Alliance, fight for freedom, and the promise of a life without tyranny. They fight harder, gaining +20% durability. Support, Repair Drones, Astromech

The last product designed by Incom before Imperial nationalization, the UT-60D U-wing is a capable troop transport and support craft, but is no fighter craft designed for direct engagements. Ever in short supply, the U-wing is equipped with a swarm of starfighter repair drones it can deploy to support allied starfighters and gunships, for 300 max HP repaired per swarm. The U-wing is best used as a support craft or durable scout thanks to its S-foils, but it remains a poor combat unit and should not be used to engage hostile fighters alone, or at all. Dispite this, deploying a few U-wings alongside other Rebel starfighters has proven to greatly boost their already considerable durability and proves the U-wing to be a worthy asset to any Rebel fleet composition, saving many a pilots starfighter and skin.

The nimble Alpha-3 Nimbus or V-wing for short offers excellent durability for a light interceptor. Equipped with rapidly recharging Interceptor shields and an astromech for onboard repairs the fast and agile V-wing excels at dogfighting light craft such as the numerous CIS' unshielded lightly armored droids it was designed to counter. Armed with low-range light repeating Lasers it lacks the firepower to take on more heavily armored craft however. While old, the V-wing is hardly obsolete when used appropriately and has proven effective against newer light fighter models such as the TIE Fighter, adding to its popularity by pirates and para-military organizations alike. Best used to dogfight lightly armored foes lacking the damage output to pierce the V-wings rapidly recharging shields.

Small Target, Dogfighter, Armor-Piercing, Interceptor Shielding, Powerful Engines

Focussing on speed and agility over all other attributes, the elegant and aerodynamic N1 Starfighter, or Naboo Starfighter is an expensive light interceptor used exclusively by the people of Naboo. The N1 is extremely small, thin, and very difficult to hit, capable of dodging even missiles while dogfighting and equipped with rapidly-recharging Interceptor Shielding quickly absorbing any light impacts and an astromech for self-repair. While the Naboo Starfighter is a high performance interceptor, it is only armed with twin repeating Light Lasers and a Homing Torpedo launcher, and its luck can quickly turn against craft with medium to heavy armor, or dedicated interceptors capable of breaching its light shields and armor. Best used to dogfight against lightly armored craft.

Those that fight for the Alliance, fight for freedom, and the promise of a life without tyranny. They fight harder, gaining +20% durability. Very Large Unit, Anti-Light, Repair Crew, SLAM Engines

The Naboo-built PT-1 uses advanced SLAM engines that would later be used on the K-wing. Focussing mostly on speed over every other trait, the PT-1 is poorly armored and shielded for a gunship, but can easily outrun most opponents. After the Battle of Naboo made clear the need for area-denial weapons, the PT-1 was armed with High Explosive missiles to quickly wipe out large groups of lightly armored craft. The Rebellion makes thankful use of these against the Empires TIE swarms.

Armor: Medium 2x Medium Laser, 2x HE-Missile Agility: 1.5 Max Speed: 7.5 SP: 220(5/s) HP: 150(1/s) 3 Models per squadron.

The Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor, also known as the Jedi Interceptor, was a Republic air superiority fighter produced by Kuat Systems Engineering shortly before the Clone Wars. It was primarily designed for use by the Jedi Order, necessitating a craft that was hyper maneuverable and with explosive acceleration potential. The modern iterations of the Delta-7 possess a modest armament and an internal hyperspace drive, eschewing the need for the bulky Hyperspace ring of the past. Best used to dogfight lightly armored foes and to stall heavy armored craft until backup arrives.

Armor: Light 2x Light Laser Agility: 2.0 Max Speed: 4.0 SP: 25(4.5/s) HP: 40(1/s) 8 Models per squadron.

Those that fight for the Alliance, fight for freedom, and the promise of a life without tyranny. They fight harder, gaining +20% durability. Very Large Unit, Anti-Large, Ion Torpedo, Expert Dogfighter, Heavily Armed, Multi-Role, Adv. Armor & Materials, Repair Crew, High Capacity Shielding, SLAM

The New Republic's massive BTL-S8 K-wing dual-seater gunship is the latest in anti-starship hardware. Propelled by SubLight Acceleration Motors (SLAM), protected by High-Capacity Shielding and equipped with advanced ordance, while the K-wing is not armed with many Proton Torpedoes, its Plasma and Ion Torpedoes instead focus on powering directly through shields while debuffing the targets firepower. Its expensive Sonic-Missiles protect the K-wing from starfighters. The BTL-S8 is particularly vulnerable to single-target damage by Missiles and even turbolaser fire due to its large size, and a sustained assault will drain the K-wings impressive shield strength. While the K-wing is undeniably powerful, its high costs makes it generally cost-ineffective compared to standard bombers and is best used as ultra-heavy firesupport to other bombers.

Armor: Heavy 2x Light Turbolaser Turret, 2x Medium Laser Turret, 4x Proton Torpedo, 2x Ion Torpedo, 2x Plasma Torpedo, 8x AP-Missile, 2x Sonic-Missile Agility: 1.5 Max Speed: 7.5 SP: 650(15/s) HP: 340(1/s) 2 Models per squadron.

Plasma torpedo: powerful debuff, outstanding vs shields, no hull DMG. 1250 DMG vs starship shields, 18s reload, 450m range. Applies -33% Max SP debuff to Corvette/Frigate/Capital/Structure for 14s Sonic missile: long-ranged, very large AOE, high DMG, no shield penetration. 30 ||| 30 | 28 | 25 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 15s reload, 575m range.

Land Bombing Run Unit Bombing Run Ordnance: High Explosive Bombs, effective against large concentractions of units. Bombing Run Type: Single drop, 1 massive high explosive bomb

A prolific smuggler who is a lifelong enemy of Prince Xizor and the Galactic Empire for crimes against his family. Dash and his faithful droid co-pilot LE-BO2D9 -called Leebo- are allies of the Rebel Alliance serving as transport for personnel, weapons and other cargo to support the war effort and from time to time using his skills as a pilot in battle.

Outrider is an illegally modified CEC YT-2400 Light Freighter owned and piloted by Dash Rendar. Specializing in smuggling operations that make it able to avoid detection across the galaxy but also in emergencies can vanish from enemy sensors for a short time and passively scrabbles short ranged scanners which can disrupt enemy missile tracking around the ship. The modifications also extend to it’s combat ability such as reinforced armor plating given the ship its signature silver coloring. Its shields are power boosted as well granting the ship excellent protection. The weapon systems were not ignored, featuring a pair of remote controlled Dual Heavy Laser Cannon turrets and a pair of concussion missile launchers all linked to a special targeting computer providing more range and accuracy than normal.

Agility: 1.8 Max Speed: 3.8 SP: 250(12/s) HP: 600(2/s)

Those that fight for the Alliance, fight for freedom, and the promise of a life without tyranny. They fight harder, gaining +20% durability. Very Large Unit, Dogfighter, Brittle Steel, Repair Crew

The Incom built X4 gunship is a firesupport gunship with excellent firearcs thanks to its turrets. These make the X4 well-suited to be a dogfighter, although its relatively weakly armored hull makes it more vulnerable than other gunships. It's speed and maneuverability is also unremarkable, and while the X4 is a welcome addition to the Alliance unit roster, capable of shooting TIEs in any direction, it is also the most unimpressive craft on that list. Best used to dogfight alongside other Alliance craft. Especially vulnerable against hostile torpedoes due to its size and low HP, the X4 is particularly ill-suited to hunt down TIE Bombers or other bomber craft against which it has no defence other than its flares.

Those that fight for the Alliance, fight for freedom, and the promise of a life without tyranny. They fight harder, gaining +20% durability. Very Large Unit, Anti-Large, Heavily Armed, Terrible Dogfighter, Repair Crew, High Capacity Shielding

Where other Incom-built designs such as the T-65 X-wing or UT-60 U-wing were well-balanced and sophisticated designs, the monstrously large XB-17 super heavy tactical bomber, or "The big dumb bomber" as it came to be known, was far less elegant. A heavily reinforced hull protected by thick armor plating were prioritized over speed and agility, and even the previously planned variable s-foil mechanism was replaced by static radiators encased in plating. The sheer amount of raw materials required to construct and maintain such a fleet of massive dedicated bomber craft were unavailable to the resource-strapped Rebellion, and by the time the Alliance had secured the means for supporting the mass production the XB-17 was seemingly built for, better options for powerful bomber craft were available to the Rebellion.

Built intentionally as a slow flying fortresses in the days of the Republic to prevent usage by pirates, the heavily armored Gozanti is an extremely durable gunship and transport equipped with repair drones it can use to facilitate repairs to itself or nearby craft. Armed with heavy laser turrets and a forward-mounted torpedo launcher it is easily capable of defending itself against large units and hostile gunships, but its appalling agility and top speed make it an easy target for heavy weaponry. Nevertheless it performs its intended duty admirably as the Gozanti has seen many decades of service and continues to stay relevant in the age of the Empire. Best used to tank endless volleys of small-arms fire and support surrounding craft with its repair drones.

Princess Leia of the Royal House of Organa of Alderaan. Leia is as vicious on the battlefield as she is at the negotiations table. An ardent supporter of the values of the old Republic and a founding member of the Rebel Alliance at her father Bail Organa’s side. Unknowingly strong in the force granting her visions of her mother in her dreams and so free spirited that she’d even make out with someone she’s always known was her brother.

Organa commands the Tantive IV alongside Captain Raymus Antilles and her personal droids C-3P0 and R2-D2 who sometimes pulls double duty with Commander Skywalker’s X-Wing. Tantive IV has increased armor compared to other CR90-class Corvettes allowing it to withstand several shots from an Imperial-class Star Destroyer and the droids onboard inspired by the war hero R2-D2 are quick to make repairs in battle. The ship being a diplomatic vessel of Alderaan allows for the vessel to remain undetected while it travels the galaxy for Rebel activity.

Fleet commander: Princess Leia's natural talent in aggressive negotiations inspire all corvettes on the battlefield to have 15% increased shield power and 10% increased movement speed.

Always stacks with other fleet commander bonuses.

Special Structures: R_Shipyard_1 R_Uplink_Command

The Crusader-class Droid Platform, otherwise known by its class designation XX-777, is an entirely automated warship produced by a joint venture between the Corellian Engineering and Loronar Corporations. Despite these core world origins, the XX-777 sees widespread usage among Separatist Holdout groups due to their robust corporate espionage network. It functions in both a long-range Ion fire-support role as well as providing some Anti-corvette and Anti-gunship protection thanks to its specialized missile loadout.

A highly respected Chandrilan politician who serves as the leader of the of the Rebel Alliance and would later serve as the Chief of State for the New Republic. She made her mark in the waning days of the old Republic by joining the Delegation of 2000, the legislative movement that formed the core of the Rebellion in the Imperial era. Mothma led Senate opposition to early Imperial activities at great personal risk, eventually prompting a crackdown that forced her to openly declare a Rebellion against the Empire. Her dignity, grace under pressure and strength of character make her a guiding light to many within the galaxy.

The Great Unifier: Mon Mothma facilitates compromise and cohesion wherever she focuses her attention, resulting in a 20% discount on all purchases.

A Quasar Fire-class Carrier commanded by General Jan Dodonna, Head of the Alliance Starfighter Corps. The Victory -named after the Victory-class Star Destroyer fleet he commanded in the Clone Wars- serves as his testing site for the new prototype A-Wing Interceptor he helped develop and a mobile base with which to operate them from across the galaxy.

Max speed: 1.75; Shieldpoints: 4500; Hitpoints: 3000; 2 A-Wing (8)

Fleet commander: General Dodonna’s background in the Republic Navy and his extensive knowledge of starfighters provides a 15% Increase to shield strength and a 10% engine power increase for all Republic Starfighters and A-Wings in battle he is present for.

Always stacks with other fleet commander bonuses.

The Sullustian Liberator-class is a sleek capital ship that serves as a durable carrier unit. Equipped with large internal hangars and heavy ion cannons, it can withstand hostile capital ships by stunning them, allowing its garrison and escort to pick them appart savely. Excellent as a durable center of fleet formations, but generally unable to deal more than token damage to armor. An escort consistent of high-damage warships is advised.

Max speed: 2.5; Shield points: 15000; Hit points: 15000; 2 X-Wing (4), 1 Y-Wing (2), 2 B-Wing (4)

Maintenance: This starship costs 100 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

The Sullustian Liberator-class is a sleek capital ship that serves as a durable carrier unit. Equipped with large internal hangars and heavy ion cannons, it can withstand hostile capital ships by stunning them, allowing its garrison and escort to pick them appart savely. Excellent as a durable center of fleet formations, but generally unable to deal more than token damage to armor. An escort consistent of high-damage warships is advised.

As a utility vessel, the slow and combat incapable Modular Taskforce Cruiser is a prime target for piracy, and despite the Empires best efforts to defend their precious logistics vessels, several have ended up in the hands of the Black Sun and even the Rebellion.

The MTC was designed by the Empire to efficiently provide a variety of logistics solutions, by swapping between mission function modules. It's capabilities include natural disaster relieve, post combat search & rescue, repair & salvage operations, planetary suppression and pacification, rapid planetary and system exploration, including natural resource surveys to swiftly assess the viability of newly found systems to support colonization. In combat the slow Modular Taskforce Cruiser is completely incapable of defending itself, and can be deployed only as a support craft to a larger fleet.

Fleet Logistics & Repair Module: This module provides a construction cost and time reduction of 15% to Corvettes, 10% to Frigates and 5% to Capital ships on the planet the MTC is stationed. This bonus does not stack with multiple MTCs. In combat, it repairs Corvettes, Frigates and Capital ships in an area around the MTC, and can deploy fields of repair drones for repairs further away.

Max speed: 2.0; Shield points: 10000; Hit points: 10000; 1 U-Wing (0), 1 X4 (1)

Garm Bel Iblis is one of the three founding members of the Alliance. Commands the Peregrine. A Dreadnaught-class Heavy Cruiser once a part of Katana Fleet that now serves as the flagship of his personal forces within the Corellian Resistance. Peregrine is modified with increased firepower from the standard model Dreadnaughts in that it has Ion Cannon batteries.

Fleet commander: Garm Bel Iblis is a pragmatic founding member of the Rebel Alliance, often advocating for the destruction of ones enemies over self-preservation. In combat, he puts this in practice, redirecting power for corvettes and frigates from Shield Points (-35%) to Damage (+20%) and Movement Speed (+20%).

Always stacks with other fleet commander bonuses.

The Liberation is one of the few remaining Venator-class Star Destroyers used during the Clone Wars. Its “C.O.” Captain Shack served in the republic navy under Jedi General Rahm Kota who insisted on using his own militia forgoing clones. Captain Shack is a career officer, known for his aggressive strategies and unique leadership style which left his allies and enemies largely confused.

“I take my oath to the Republic very seriously“ - Captain Shack

Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser. An ancient battleship of the Republic designed over three-thousand years ago when large warships ruled the stars before advancement in weapon tech rendered them obsolete. Cheap and easy to acquire in the modern age, these vessels are ideally suited for anti-piracy duty and a powerful missile platform despite the relatively light laser armament for such a massive warship. The CSA makes extensive use of these vessels to protect their interests.

Max speed: 2; Shield points: 10000; Hit points: 24000

Maintenance: This starship costs 200 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Its two micro-torpedo batteries can take down shielded hardpoints, and can be overcharged to fire faster. Effective at prolonged broadsides at close range.

Rebel One has acted as a mobile headquarters for Rebel fighter operations, being modified to service strike craft of the Alliance rather than the droid starfighter It was originally made for. The one of first MC80 of her subclass, Liberty has had a long service as a flagship in the Alliance under the command of Admiral Yamarus. The ship has served as the headquarters for Green Squadron and the veteran ace pilot Ace Azzameen who has led Liberty through many flight operations.

An elite interceptor wing of the Rebel Alliance known as Green Squadron led by Commander Arvel Crynyd. A steadfast ace pilot of the Rebellion said to be more dedicated than others and flies his A-Wing as if guided by a divine wind to strike at the enemies of the Rebellion.

Armor: Heavy 2x Swiveling Light Laser, 1x Ion-Pulse Missile -/- 1x Concussion Missile Agility: 3.0 Max Speed: 4.0 SP: 20(4.5/s) HP: 40 6 Models per squadron.

Light laser: rapid-fire, short-ranged, weak vs armor 5 ||| 5 | 4 | 2 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 0.5s reload, 150m range. Ion-pulse missile: crippling debuff, long-ranged, AOE, no hull DMG. 20 DMG vs S, 15s reload, 575m range. Completely disables shields to Fighter/Bomber in a medium area for 14s. Concussion missile: crippling debuff, long-Ranged, no shield penetration. 20 ||| 20 | 15 | 8 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 15s reload, 500m range. Applies -85% Firerate debuff to Fighter/Bomber for 12s.

Mon Calamari-80-class. The winged variant of the MC-80 has more weapons and stronger shields. While not very effective at ship vs ship combat, the MC-80 is well defended against starfighters with its many laser cannons. Heavily shielded and lightly armored, the MC-80 is vulnerable to shield penetrating weapons.

Endurance-class Star Destroyer. A variant of the Nebula spaceframe having all the armor and shield advancements of it’s cousin. Configured to act as a combat carrier much like Venators of old, the Endurance is loaded with the best of the New Republic’s starfighters. It’s shift to a carrier role however leaves the ship much weaker in a ship-to-ship engagement compared to the Nebula.

Max speed: 3; Shield points: 30000; Hit points: 30000; 1 X-Wing (2), 2 E-Wing (4), 1 Y-Wing (2), 1 K-Wing (1)

Rebel Tide is one of the first MC80-class Star Cruisers repurposed for the Rebel Alliance falling into the MC-80a line. Captained by Commander Gail Ackbar who learned to explain Imperial naval doctrine's weaknesses while serving as personal slave of Grand Moff Tarkin. The Rebel Tide features a larger hangar bay compared to standard MC-80a and a deployable repair field.

Commander Ackbar's plans rely on speed and close quarters brawling, granting bombers, corvettes and frigates an additional +40% Movement Speed, 30% Shield Strength and +10% Damage.

Fleet commander: Commander Ackbar's plans rely on speed and close quarters brawling, granting bombers, corvettes and frigates an additional +40% Movement Speed, 30% Shield Strength and +10% Damage.

Always stacks with other fleet commander bonuses.

Effective at taking large amounts of damage and taking down shields quickly.

Max speed: 3; Shield points: 70000; Hit points: 64000; 1 X-Wing (3); 1 Y-Wing (3) 1 A-Wing (3); 1 B-Wing (3), 1 X4 Gunship (2)

Always stacks with other fleet commander bonuses.

An MC80 Home One-class Cruiser under the command of General Crix Madine. Independence once served as the flagship of the Rebel Alliance prior to Admiral Ackbar transferring command to Home One. General Madine has kept his command on the vessel as a flagship for his commando and intelligence operations. Due to General Madine’s history as an Imperial officer he runs Independence as a tight ship to his standards. This involves rerouting power to the weapons systems rather than to the shield generators like most Mon Calamari vessels.

Max speed: 3; Shield points: 70000; Hit points: 64000; 2 Z-95 (6), 1 X-Wing (3), 1 Y-Wing (3), 1 U-Wing (2)

Fleet commander: General Madine is a veteran of the Empire. He’s best at using their own tactics against them and adapting their efficiencies into Rebel military structure. As such capital ships under his command gain a 15% Increase in engine power at the cost of 10% shield strength.

Always stacks with other fleet commander bonuses.

Required Planets: MonCalamari
Special Structures: R_Shipyard_3 R_Uplink_Command

Lucrehulk-class Droid-Control Ship. Originally cargo haulers, the Lucrehulks of the Trade Federation were pushed into military service during the Clone Wars, proving useful as massive transports capable of carrying thousands of droids. As warships, they were effective against the Republics carrier-oriented Venators. With the advent of the Empire and its doctrine of heavy, ship-to-ship combat oriented warships, the Lucrehulk has lost much of its former potency. It is still however, a well-shielded and armored supercarrier.

Max speed: 2.5; Shield points: 55000; Hit points: 55200; 6 Vulture Fighter (16), 4 Hyena Bomber (12), 2 TriFighter Interceptor (4)

Maintenance: This starship costs 3600 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Required Planets (Neutral, Rebel, Underworld): Mustafar, Muunilinst, Cato_Neimoidia, Nimban, Pammant, Neimoidia, Foerost, MonCalamari
Special Structures (Rebel): R_Shipyard_3
Special Structures (Underworld): U_Shipyard_3

Reserve max: 5x Vulture_Droid_Garrison, 4x Hyena_Droid_Garrison, 1x Tri_Fighter_Garrison

Lucrehulk-class Battleship. Towards the end of the Clone Wars some Droid-Control Ships were modified further into battlecruisers. While no longer considered supercarriers, these warships could outgun any republic vessel and can still stand up to most heavy Star Destroyers today. Armed with significantly more weapons than the Control Ship, but carries fewer fighters.

Max speed: 2.5; Shield points: 55000; Hit points: 117600; 3 Vulture Fighter (8), 2 Hyena Bomber (6), 1 TriFighter Interceptor (2)

Maintenance: This starship costs 2200 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Required Planets (Neutral, Rebel, Underworld): Mustafar, Muunilinst, Cato_Neimoidia, Nimban, Pammant, Neimoidia, Foerost, MonCalamari
Special Structures (CIS): CIS_Shipyard_3
Special Structures (Rebel): R_Shipyard_3
Special Structures (Underworld): U_Shipyard_3

A Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter that was converted into a battleship during the Clone Wars and is now used by the Rebel Alliance as a mobile headquarters and fighter carrier. This vessel boats an impressive compliment of X-Wing Starfighters making it much more deadly than any Lucrehulk in history.

Mandator-2-class Star Battlecruiser. A fast but lightly shielded battlecruiser designed during the Clone Wars. Because of its focus on ship-to-ship combat instead of the carrier role traditionally favoured by the Republic, this ship has also seen service in the Imperial Navy.

Max speed: 6; Shieldpoints: 60000; Hitpoints: 260000; 2 V-Wing (6), 2 ARC-170 (6), 1 Gozanti (1)

Maintenance: This starship costs 4275 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Required Planets: Ringo_Vinda, Rendili, Rothana, Allanteen
Special Structures: R_Shipyard_3

The Viscount-class Star Defender is the hulking Dreadnaught of the New Republic and symbolic of its new status as a Galactic Superpower. Designated by the Mon Calamari as the MC-153, the Star Defender was intended to decisively engage Super Star Destroyers. It serves as the tip of the spear in the New Republic Navy.

The MC-153 design is armed with a large complement of heavy proton torpedo launchers and ion cannons, intended to strip opposing capital ships of their shields or bypass them entirely. It’s also deceptively fast for its size, with powerful engines to allow it to close the distance and pummel enemies at close range. From there, the vessel utilizes powerful, dispersed shield generators to tank extreme amounts of damage.

Max Speed: 6; Shieldpoints: 400000; Hitpoints: 900000; 4 X-Wing (8); 8 E-Wing (36); 1 Elite A-Wing (2); 4 Y-Wing (12); 2 K-Wing (6); 1 Elite B-Wing (2)

Maintenance: This starship costs 5700 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Venator-class Light Star Destroyer. The Venator-class was the capital ship of choice for the Galactic Republic due to its fighter carrying capacity. All Star Destroyers have long range but slow firing weapons.

Vindicator-class Heavy Cruiser. A frontline frigate developed by Seinar Fleet Systems, the Vindicator is a strong wolfpack ship that specializes against corvettes and smaller frigates with its accurate medium ion cannons and dual turbolasers. In high numbers it can present a serious threat against larger targets. While durable and powerful for its size, it lacks anti-starfighter defence, and so needs protection from hostile bombers.

Victory I-class Star Destroyer. Designed during the Clone Wars, the Victory I was the Republic Navy’s first iteration of a larger ship-to-ship combat vessel to support the Venator-class. This greater offensive capability is primarily derived from its large number of concussion missile tubes, capable of devastating alpha strikes on enemy shield generators. However, its engines are slow and inefficient, leaving the Victory-class vulnerable to falling out of position and struggling to keep pace with faster fleets.

The Victory-II 'Longbow' frigate is an intermediate-ranged anti-fighter vessel that acts as a screening frigate within the Republic and Imperial navies. It features an array of laser cannons and turbolasers to fend off small enemy craft, alongside its bow mounted strikecraft targeting missile system. Despite its respectable performance in the Clone Wars and early Imperial era, the Victory-II saw diminished usage over time thanks to increased corvette performance and overshadowing by carrier-based fighter solutions.

Victory II-class Light Star Destroyer. Originally planned as a life extension program for the Victory I, the design diverged significantly enough that it was designated the Victory II. This late Clone Wars era vessel features improved engines compared to its predecessor, Heavy MagPulse missiles and strong Ion Cannons. The Victory II benefits from being grouped with fire support vessels, as it can struggle to secure a kill after striping the shields. Vulnerable to heavily armored warships. Effective at long range shield support.

Procursator-class Medium Star Destroyer. Also known as the "pocket destroyer", the Procursator destroyer has sacrificed all versatility to sport heavy firepower, a powerful shield generator, and heavy armor. While still relatively cheap, the Procursator can overpower any ship in its price range. Exceptionally well suited for ship vs ship combat and providing heavy firesupport. Very vulnerable to fighters and bombers. All Star Destroyers have long range but slow firing weapons.

Max speed: 3.0; Shield points: 15000; Hit points: 20000

Maintenance: This starship costs 290 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Secutor-class Heavy Star Destroyer. The Secutor-class was a heavy warship that saw service in the last days of the Republic. It is a more combat-focused starcruiser than the Venator-class while maintaining a sizable fighter garrison. All Star Destroyers have long range but slow firing weapons.

Imperial-1-class Heavy Star Destroyer. Equipped with weak shields but very thick armor, the ISD-1 is excellent at outlasting enemy warships. Its primary batteries, located besides its superstructure, have long fire range. While the ISD-1 does not possess a lot of firepower, the combination of high range weapons and durability have made it a formidable warship. Effective at long range ship vs ship combat. Vulnerable to bombers. All Star Destroyers have long range but slow firing weapons.

Imperial-2-class Heavy Star Destroyer. The ISD-2 takes the solid concept of the ISD-1 and improves it further, particularly boosting firepower. Its primary batteries have been upgraded from dual to octuple turbolasers, and it replaces its 6 trench-based laser cannons with ion cannons. The ISD-2 also gains 33% more shieldstrength and carries TIE Interceptors instead of TIE Fighters. While a marked improvement over the ISD-1, the ISD-2 is a significantly more expensive warship, and still relies on imperial doctrine of slow-firing but longer range weapons. Effective at long range ship vs ship combat. Vulnerable to bombers. All Star Destroyers have long range but slow firing weapons.

Max speed: 3; Shield points: 20000; Hit points: 42000; 2 X-Wing (4), 1 X4 Gunship (0)

DH-Omni Support Vessel. Originally a corporate transport manufactured by Hoersch-Kessel Drive Inc, the DH-Omnis were pushed into Confederate military service during the Clone Wars, proving useful as massive transports capable of carrying thousands of droids. These poorly armed support vessels can replenish the armaments needs of a moderately sized fleet for weeks, though they require escorts.

Max speed: 2.5; Shield points: 8000; Hit points: 13500; 1 X-Wing (3), 1 V-Wing (3), 1 Y-Wing (3)

This unit gives combat bonuses to its fleet: Health +5%, Shields +10% and 10% Defensive power. These bonuses DO NOT stack with other DH-Omni bonus effects but DO stack with those provided by other bonus categories.

Maintenance: This starship costs 200 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Required Planets: Mustafar, Muunilinst, Cato_Neimoidia, Nimban, Pammant, Neimoidia, Foerost, MonCalamari
Special Structures: R_Shipyard_3

Small Target, Weak, Dogfighter

The Variable Geometry Self-Propelled Battle Droid, or simply Vulture Droid, is a small unmanned fighter that relies on numbers to overwhelm the enemy. While the droid was only lightly armored and armed, it was fairly fast and maneuverable, and helped by its small target profile the Vulture is hard to hit making it surprisingly durable while dogfighting. Produced en mass, these cheap droids were deployed in the thousands at a time by the CIS during the Clone Wars. Best used to swarm lightly armored starfighters, and buy time for more capable fighters to arrive.

Small Target, Dogfighter, Glass Cannon, Powerful Engines

Designed by Colicoid Creation Nest, who also designed the Droideka, the Tri-Fighter is a high-performance space superiority droid. While lightly armored, the Tri-Fighter is fast, agile and presents a small target profile making it deadly in a dogfight. Equipped with Discord missiles that deliver Buzz Droids to the target, the Tri-Fighter is able to lower the max HP of fighters, bombers and gunships, allowing it to pick apart its prey. Best used in a dogfight in support of lighter craft (such as Vulture Droids) that cannot by themselves take on high HP targets.

Armor: Light 1x Medium Laser, 3x Discord Missile Agility: 2.1 Max Speed: 4.25 HP: 21 8 Models per squadron.

Medium laser: mid-ranged, good vs armor. 12 ||| 12 |10 | 8 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 2.0s reload, 250m range. Discord missile: mid-ranged, small AOE, no shield penetration. 5 ||| 5 | 4 | 2 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 15s reload, 375m range. Applies -33% HP debuff to Fighter/Bomber/Gunship in a small area for 30s.

Large Unit, Dogfighter, Glass Cannon, Burstfire

Designed for in-atmosphere airstrikes, the Heavy Missile Platform Droid is a relatively small but very well-armed gunboat. In space the HMP is a very capable fire-support craft, capable of shooting down most starfighters thanks to its impressive missile barrage, however it is vulnerable to countermeassures. For self-defense, the HMP is equipped with two forward-fixed Medium Lasers, two dual Light Laser turrets and a single Medium laser turret offering excellent coverage around the gunship. While the HMP is impressively armed and relatively well-shielded for its small size, it lacks hull strength and is best used as a fire-support unit as opposed to a stand-alone craft. Excellent when combined with light fighters such as Vulture or Tri-Fighter droids.

Dogfighter, Heavy, Sturdy, Indigenous

The hardy Utapauan Porax-38 features strong High-Capacity shields and thick armor, but also achieved notoriety for its modular design. While durable, the Porax presents a sizable target profile while turning and suffers from poor handling in a dive. This makes it especially vulnerable to anti-large weaponry while dogfighting, where it relies on its flares to counteract missile ordnance. Despite these shortcomings, its survivability and customization options made it a favored craft among bounty hunters or forward-deployed escorts long after the Clone Wars.

5 Models per squadron. Built by Collicoid Creation Nest, the Trident is a heavy assault droid combining thrust vectoring with four large mechanical arms. Capable of operating both in-atmosphere and outer space, the Trident is a versatile attack platform. In space it is far more agile than similar units. Its offensive systems include Heavy Laser turrets, its own arms and an optional assault drill. A strong shield generator protects the relatively weak hull of the droid, and while it can assist in shooting down incoming minor ordnance and screening starfighters, the squadron will quickly suffer loses against stronger enemy Corvettes or Frigates.

Corvettes are highly agile warships that can be outfitted to perform a large variety of tasks. They are easily produced, and aided by their adaptability and Point-Defense systems Corvettes make excellent escort ships.

The Petranaki, or Justice in Geonosian, cruiser is a thin, agile warship. While it is equipped with capable dual turbolaser turrets, the Petranaki excels at starfighter screening with its large banks of medium laser cannons and accurate long-range proton beam cannon. Excellent as support ship, but fragile. For best results, keep in the middle or back of your fleet and orient the nose towards opposing forces.

Subjugator-class Battlecruiser. The Subjugator is equipped with two heavy ion blast cannons. While not particularly powerful for its size, its ion cannons can disable any starship, leaving it defenseless against the Subjugators heavy forward firepower and large fighter garrison. Targets hit by the ion blast lose 99% speed and 75% firepower for 15 minutes. To use the ion cannons, make sure the Subjugator faces the target by right clicking it, then activate the ability. The Subjugator will execute the fire order by rotating into position manually. Very effective against single targets, vulnerable against large spread-out fleets.

Max speed: 4; Shieldpoints: 200000; Hitpoints: 375000; 1 Droid Assault Wing (2)

Maintenance: This starship costs 3600 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Max Build Limit: 1 (zero)

Ignores Nebulae, Small Target, Dogfighter, Solar Sails, Interceptor Shielding, Powerful Engines

This unit ignores the effect of nebulae on its shields.

The expensive Miy'Tok Starfighter comes fully equipped with an advanced power management system and two solar sails, generating additional power for its engines, shield generator and weapon systems, providing a boost to the Miy'Tok's combat performance. More capable than the small and nimble Miy'Tok interceptor, the larger Miy'Tok is a capable fighter craft, its only real weakness being its large target profile due to its sail, and lack of heavy weaponry to combat heavily armored foes. Best used to dogfight lightly armored craft.

Large Unit, Anti-Large, Ion Torpedo, Armor-Piercing, Astromech, High Capacity Shielding, Powerful Engines

The large Miy'Til Bomber is a fast and durable heavy strike bomber deployed on rare occasions by the Hapes Consortium. With an emphasis on speed and durability it can outrun most fighter craft, especially when diverting additional power to its already powerful engines. It can execute fast hit & run strikes, heavily debuffing the shields and armor of an enemy starship upon hit to support friendly starships, or stay around for longer and deal serious damage to both shields and armor with its dual ion and advanced torpedo launchers. Best used to attack and debuff large enemy starships, bringing down the shields and armor of hostile craft to more manageable levels for the rest of the Hapan Starfleet to take on.

Armor: Heavy 2x Medium Laser, 2x Adv. Proton Torpedo, 2x Ion Torpedo Agility: 1.725 Max Speed: 4.0 SP: 55(3/s) HP: 70 5 Models per squadron.

Adv Proton torpedo: ignores shields, great vs armor. 26 | 25 | 24 DMG vs L | M | H armor, 15s reload, 475m range. Applies -33% Max HP debuff to Fighter/Bomber/Gunship/Corvette for 14s Ion torpedo: crippling debuff, great vs shields, no hull DMG. 500 DMG vs starship shields, 15s reload, 375m range. Applies -33% Max SP, firepower, speed debuff to Corv/Frig/Cap/Structure for 14s

Hapan Battle Dragon. The main ship of the line for the Hapan Royal Navy, the Battle Dragon is as elegant as it is efficient. It can maintain a surprising volume of firepower towards any one target by synchronizing its weapon reload speed with the rotation of the two dishes they are mounted on. Dispite its small size, this allows the Dragon to spew a hail of turbolaser and ion cannon fire at its target. While this makes the Battle Dragon an amazingly effective ship against single targets, it cannot focuss its supremely optimized fire sequence at more than one target at a time.

This unit ignores the effect of nebulae on its shields.

Max speed: 3.0; Shieldpoints: 8000; Hitpoints: 8000; 1 Miy'Til Bomber (1), 1 Miy'Tok Fighter (1)

Maintenance: This starship costs 120 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Dogfighter, Anti-Light, Adv. Armor, Glass Cannon, Heavily Armed

The Basilisk War Droid is an ancient, mountable, semi-sentient, unshielded aircraft whos head is made up entirely of guns. Flanking the rider are two missile launchers and a pair of arms equipped with long durasteel claws. While designed 4000 years ago these updated models come equipped with advanced armor, and foldable wings for added in-atmosphere stability. Best used against lightly armored craft, where these warmachines can shred whole squadrons in single volleys. As the designated light-armor wrecking crew the Mandalorian Crusaders used to ride these babies for miles!

Armor: Heavy 2x Light Laser, 1x Medium Laser, 2x HE-Missile Agility: 1.875 Max Speed: 3.0 HP: 35(1/s) 7 Models per squadron.

Light laser: rapid-fire, short-ranged, weak vs armor 5 ||| 5 | 4 | 2 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 0.5s reload, 150m range. Medium laser: mid-ranged, good vs armor. 12 ||| 12 |10 | 8 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 2.0s reload, 250m range. High-explosive missile: long-Ranged, AOE, weak vs armor, no shield penetration. 15 ||| 15 | 8 | 4 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 20s reload, 500m range.

Formation

Very Large Unit, Expert Dogfighter, Heavily Armed, Adv. Armor & Materials, Repair Crew, High Capacity Shielding, Powerful Engines

Of Mandalorian design, the M22-T Krayt Gunship was originally commissioned by Jabba the Hutt as a high-performance commandship for his lieutenantes. Like the Krayt Dragon it was named after, the M22 is a hunter. Its oversized engine provides a high top speed for a gunship and characteristic of Mandalorian design, the Krayt is heavily armed with forward-facing Ion Cannons, rapid-fire Heavy Lasers, HE and AP Missiles, enabling the Krayt to hunt any foe. For self-defence the M22 is well-shielded and equipped with a quad Light Laser turret offering excellent coverage around the gunship. Its head-on barrage may be beastly due to its many forward-facing heavy weapons, but the Krayt needs to lign up a shot due to its lack of turreted weaponry more akin to starfighters than gunships, a major weakness for any large unit. Besides this downside and a vulnerability to missiles and torpedoes that characterizes large units, the Krayt Gunship is the bane of any starfighter or gunship.

Armor: Heavy 6x (in 2) Heavy Laser, 4x Light Laser Turret, 2x HE-Missile, 2x AP-Missile Agility: 1.75 Max Speed: 5.0 SP: 450(15/s) HP: 450(1/s) 2 Models per squadron.

Heavy laser: long-ranged, great vs armor. 24 ||| 24 | 23 | 21 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 3.0s reload, 450m range. Ion cannon: powerful debuff, mid-ranged, good vs shield, very accurate. 25 DMG vs S armor, 2s reload, 300m range. Applies -50% Firerate debuff to fighter/bomber for 8s. Armor-piercing missile: long-ranged, great vs armor, no shield penetration. 20 ||| 20 | 19 | 18 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 15s reload, 500m range. High-explosive missile: long-Ranged, AOE, weak vs armor, no shield penetration. 15 ||| 15 | 8 | 4 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 20s reload, 500m range.

Jehavey'ir-class Assault Ship. Built 4000 years ago by the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, the Jehavey'ir, or "Ambush" in Mandalorian, is a heavy assault corvette designed for heavy duty ship-to-ship combat. Equipped with heavy shields and armor, heavy concussion missiles, heavy ion cannons, and dual turbolasers, the Jehavey is the embodiment of Mandalorian power in a small package.

Kyramud-class Battleship is a capital ship dating back to the Mandalorian Wars where it served as the mainstay of the Neo-Crusader fleet. A heavily armored insectoid vessel that while quite large features limited armament for its size and relying on it's bulk, beskar armor shell, and compliment of Basilisk Wardroids to protect it while it unleashes long ranged missile barrages from it's 10 missile launchers.

Formation

Armor-Piercing, Dogfighter, Interceptor Shielding, Advanced Engines

An ancient starfighter that has survived four millennia in use in countless fleets across the galaxy. Famed for its light, nimble frame, moderate shielding and heavy armament. The already impressive speed of the craft is even more improved at the cost of weapon power with s-foils. All these features have given the Aurek-class Tactical Stikefighter a long and impressive history. The One-Two punch of the Proton Torpedo shaving off the hull of a target starfighter and Medium Lasers packing a strong punch makes the Aurek have a strong alpha strike while it’s speed and fast recharging Interceptor Shields allows it to evade reprisal from slower or slow firing enemies. This however means the Aurek is vulnerable to fast interceptors with rapid fire lasers or missile weapons that can punch through the shields to the weak hull.

Armor: Medium 2x Swiveling Medium Laser, 1x Proton Torpedo Agility: 2.55 Max Speed: 4.0 SP: 20(4.5/s) HP: 30 6 Models per squadron.

Medium laser: mid-ranged, good vs armor. 12 ||| 12 |10 | 8 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 2.0s reload, 250m range. Proton torpedo: ignores shields, good vs armor, inaccurate. 20 | 18 | 16 DMG vs L | M | H armor, 15s reload, 425m range. Applies -25% Max HP debuff to Fighter/Bomber/Gunship/Corvette for 14s

This is the only Hammerhead you're ever going to get so stop asking us! The Hammerhead-class Cruiser was the staple of the Old Republic starfleet for over 3000 years. It's forward-facing long range main turbolaser cannons in combination with its small hangar made for a versatile light frigate with great forward range. But, the Hammerhead is vulnerable from any direction but its front aside from two anti-starfighter laser batteries, and after its hugely succesful lifespan the Hammerhead was eventually phased out in favour of ships without this weakness. A well-rounded light frigate ideal for long range fire-support.

Max speed: 2.5; Shield points: 3000; Hit points: 3000; 1 Ancient Sith Fighter (0)

Hidden away in long forgotten tombs and vaults for a call that never came, these ancient ships have now been reawakened to return the glory of the Sith Empire. Massively outclassed by modern ships, the Interdictor-class is now relegated to the role of a moderately armed, interdiction-capable light cruiser. Armed with a contingent of turbolasers, the Interdictor-Class can engage similar frigates and smaller cruisers, although it lacks the means to adequately defend itself against starfighter attack.

Max Speed: 2.5; Shieldpoints: 8000; Hitpoints: 12000

Originally fielded by the Old Republic to counter heavily armed and armored Mandalorian capital ships, the refitted Centurion-class remains a formidable warship even in modern times. Now utilized by Sith Cultists as a heavily armored and heavy proton torpedo-armed capital ship, the battlecruiser serves as a heavy ordinance platform capable of strong AOE damage. It remains vulnerable to starfighter attacks and requires fighter escort.

Harrower-class Dreadnought. An ancient warship of the Resurgent Sith Empire. Famed for the siege of the capitol of the Galactic Republic on the orders of the mad Sith Emperor and his followers making the sith great again. The Harrower is covered in turbolasers across it’s massive hull, making it a true Dreadnought of its age. This however makes it vulnerable to highly shielded vessels and starfighters. Harrower makes up for its lack of anti-starfighter weapons with enough holes in its body to become a fry cook at the Krusty Krab. Each opening is a hangar filled with ancient Sith Fighters.

Max speed: 3; Shield points: 25000; Hit points: 60000; 12 Sith Fighter (24)

Maintenance: This starship costs 1700 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Those that fight for the Alliance, fight for freedom, and the promise of a life without tyranny. They fight harder, gaining +20% durability. Small Target, Dogfighter, Anti-Light, Astromech, Interceptor Shielding

The nimble Alpha-3 Nimbus or V-wing for short offers excellent durability for a light interceptor. Equipped with rapidly recharging Interceptor shields and an astromech for onboard repairs the fast and agile V-wing excels at dogfighting light craft such as the numerous CIS' unshielded lightly armored droids it was designed to counter. Armed with low-range light repeating Lasers it lacks the firepower to take on more heavily armored craft however. While old, the V-wing is hardly obsolete when used appropriately and has proven effective against newer light fighter models such as the TIE Fighter, adding to its popularity by pirates and para-military organizations alike. Best used to dogfight lightly armored foes lacking the damage output to pierce the V-wings rapidly recharging shields.

Armor: Light 2x Light Laser Agility: 2.025 Max Speed: 4.0 SP: 18(4.5/s) HP: 28(1/s) 8 Models per squadron.

The V-19 Torrent is a true relic of the Clone Wars, increasingly phased out of service by 20 BBY in favor of V-wings and the Arc-170. This was due to its large size, lack of shields and only middling armament. However, it’s still a plucky, nimble fighter that can stall Peer-Adversaries until modern interceptor backup arrives.

Anti-Large, Dogfighter, Armor-Piercing, Astromech

The Incom built Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 was designed for the Republic in the late stages of the Clone Wars and is the predecessor to the X-Wing, also designed by Incom. While ineffective against the CIS' swarms of small droids, the Arc-170 is heavily armed and capable of piercing starship armor, making it an excellent fire-support Starfighter. It is also equipped with an astromech for onboard repairs and two rear turrets, making it a capable dogfighter, and up close its otherwise inaccurate Heavy Lasers can deal heavy damage to large targets such as gunships. Excellent when combined with V-wings to screen smaller craft that the Arc-170 itself has difficulty hitting reliably. Best used to attack large targets such as gunships or for supporting bombers against (unshielded) starships.

Armor: Medium 2x Heavy Laser, 1x Rear Light Laser Turret, 1x Proton Torpedo Agility: 1.65 Max Speed: 3.0 SP: 35(3/s) HP: 38(1/s) 6 Models per squadron.

Heavy laser: long-ranged, great vs armor. 24 ||| 24 | 23 | 21 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 3.0s reload, 450m range. Proton torpedo: ignores shields, good vs armor, inaccurate. 20 | 18 | 16 DMG vs L | M | H armor, 15s reload, 425m range. Applies -25% Max HP debuff to Fighter/Bomber/Gunship/Corvette for 14s

Those that fight for the Alliance, fight for freedom, and the promise of a life without tyranny. They fight harder, gaining +20% durability. Dogfighter, Shoddy Construction

The new standard Headhunter model is equipped with Concussion Missiles, making the Z-95 more effective than it should be at supporting friendly fighters against hostile starfighters, severely debuffing their firepower thereby allowing friendly craft to more cost-effectively deal with them. On its own, the standard Headhunter is not very good at anything but be annoying thanks to its debuff.

Dogfighter, Stealth, SLAM Engines, Droid Brain

The Nighthawk-class Droid Fighter is an advanced Stealth, Space Superiority starfighter developed by Haor Chall Engineering. It serves the Separatist Navy as a high-end interceptor thanks to its powerful armament and hyper-maneuverability. Powerful blasters can chew through armor, while those unfortunate enough to be within dogfighting range of the Nighthawk must also contend with its debuffing concussion missiles and underslung Ion Cannon turret. Best used to dogfighter high-value targets and rapidly reposition with Stealth to the next target.

Armor: Light 2x Repeating Very Heavy Laser, 2x Light Laser, 2x Concussion Missiles, 1x Ion Cannon Turret Agility: 2.3 Max Speed: 5.5 SP: 20(3/s) HP: 40 8 Models per squadron.

Light laser: rapid-fire, short-ranged, weak vs armor 5 ||| 5 | 4 | 2 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 0.5s reload, 150m range. Concussion missile: crippling debuff, long-Ranged, no shield penetration. 20 ||| 20 | 15 | 8 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 15s reload, 500m range. Applies -85% Firerate debuff to Fighter/Bomber for 12s. Ion cannon: powerful debuff, mid-ranged, good vs shield, very accurate. 25 DMG vs S armor, 2s reload, 300m range. Applies -50% Firerate debuff to fighter/bomber for 8s.

The Belbullab-22 Interceptor is an oddity among CIS forces in that it’s a manned strikecraft and possesses an onboard hyperdrive. Known for its sturdy construction, the ship benefits from moderate shielding and solid armor. The Belbullab is equipped with powerful engines capable of rapid acceleration in a straightaway but suffers from a poor turning radius while boosting.

The Incom built Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 was designed for the Republic in the late stages of the Clone Wars and is the predecessor to the X-Wing, also designed by Incom. While ineffective against the CIS' swarms of small droids, the Arc-170 is heavily armed and capable of piercing starship armor, making it an excellent fire-support Starfighter. It is also equipped with an astromech for onboard repairs and two rear turrets, making it a capable dogfighter, and up close its otherwise inaccurate Heavy Lasers can deal heavy damage to large targets such as gunships. Excellent when combined with V-wings to screen smaller craft that the Arc-170 itself has difficulty hitting reliably. Best used to attack large targets such as gunships or for supporting bombers against (unshielded) starships.

Armor: Medium 2x Heavy Laser, 1x Rear Light Laser Turret, 1x Proton Torpedo Agility: 1.65 Max Speed: 3.0 SP: 35(3/s) HP: 38(1/s) 6 Models per squadron.

The J-45 ‘Sabre’ is an advanced, twin-seat multirole fighter developed by Rothana Heavy Engineering and Koensayr Manufacturing. The Sabre features underslung missile pods that can swap between AP and HE missiles during flight. The flexibility provided by this allows the J-45 to be a versatile threat against both warships and fighters alike, though it can be punished for its lack of speed and somewhat poor turning radius. Vulnerable to high-end dedicated interceptors.

Capable of engaging enemies from all sides, it is most effective in a dogfight, dispite its poor agility and shielding.

Very Large Unit, Anti-Light, Repair Crew, SLAM Engines

The Naboo-built PT-1 uses advanced SLAM engines that would later be used on the K-wing. Focussing mostly on speed over every other trait, the PT-1 is poorly armored and shielded for a gunship, but can easily outrun most opponents. After the Battle of Naboo made clear the need for area-denial weapons, the PT-1 was armed with High Explosive missiles to quickly wipe out large groups of lightly armored craft. The Rebellion makes thankful use of these against the Empires TIE swarms.

Armor: Medium 2x Medium Laser, 2x HE-Missile Agility: 1.5 Max Speed: 7.5 SP: 220(5/s) HP: 150(1/s) 3 Models per squadron.

Those that fight for the Alliance, fight for freedom, and the promise of a life without tyranny. They fight harder, gaining +20% durability. Very-Large, Dogfighter, Glass Cannon, Repair Crew

For in-atmosphere operations there are few gunships as effective as the LAAT, but in space it is but one among many. Poorly shielded for space gunship standards and a large target, it is nontheless heavily armed with 2 AP-missile launchers, 3 laser turrets, and 4 beam cannon turrets. In space, the LAATs beam cannons are vastly less effective, firing regular laser projectiles at far closer range. Capable of engaging enemies from all sides, it is most effective in a dogfight, dispite its poor agility and shielding.

Very Large Unit, Anti-Large, Armor-Piercing, Repair Drones, Support, Adv. Materials, Repair Crew, High Capacity Shielding, Slow

Built intentionally as a slow flying fortresses in the days of the Republic to prevent usage by pirates, the heavily armored Gozanti is an extremely durable gunship and transport equipped with repair drones it can use to facilitate repairs to itself or nearby craft. Armed with heavy laser turrets and a forward-mounted torpedo launcher it is easily capable of defending itself against large units and hostile gunships, but its appalling agility and top speed make it an easy target for heavy weaponry. Nevertheless it performs its intended duty admirably as the Gozanti has seen many decades of service and continues to stay relevant in the age of the Empire. Best used to tank endless volleys of small-arms fire and support surrounding craft with its repair drones.

Armor: Heavy 4x Heavy Laser Turret, 1x Proton Torpedo Agility: 0.975 Max Speed: 1.75 SP: 280(5/s) HP: 430(1/s) 3 Models per squadron.

The Commerce Guild’s Diamond-class Cruiser is a modern refit of the Clone Wars-era transport vessel, serving as a dedicated short-range anti-starfighter corvette within Separatist Holdout insurgent groups. The warship has 18 guns, primarily Laser Cannons and Heavy Laser Flak, spread over its hull to cover all angles of approach and provide point defense capabilities. However, the Diamond’s size makes it slow and provides a larger target profile to enemies, necessitating careful positioning to avoid focused fire.

Corellian Engineering Corporation Carcus Destroyer-273-class. Fast and agile, the CD-273 is a compact heavy frigate that hits hard but is only lightly armored. It is equipped with power engines and a low range missile jammer that protects the ship from torpedo and missile fire, making up for its weak hull integrity. It can also hack into enemy systems to drain 3000 shield points over 30 seconds, and severely reduce enemy accuracy. Very effective against corvettes and light frigates. Vulnerable against heavily armored targets.

Max speed: 4; Shield points: 7500; Hit points: 6000

Maintenance: This starship costs 100 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Required Planets (Republic): Corellia
Special Structures (Rebel): R_Shipyard_2
Special Structures (Republic): Republic_Shipyard_2

Jedi Master Rahm Kota is a prominent survivor of the Jedi Purge and an early member of the Rebel Alliance. His survival was thanks to his mistrust of Clone Troopers, ensuring Kota was perfectly situated to flee with his remaining cadre of battle-hardened militia troopers after Order 66 went out. This roaming group of freedom fighters cause chaos behind Imperial lines and repeatedly prove lethal to any Jedi hunters sent after their leader.

General Kota’s ship is the ‘Invictus’, a Hapan Nova-class acquired under mysterious circumstances. The vessel has been heavily modified, improving its weapons loadout and durability.

This unit ignores the effect of nebulae on its shields.

Max speed: 3.5; Shieldpoints: 10000; Hitpoints: 5000 T1: 1 Z-95 Headhunter (1) T2: 1 X-Wing Fighter (1)

A grizzled Jedi General and veteran of the Clone Wars, Master Rahm Kota is a prominent military strategist in the Rebel Alliance and serves on the Alliance High Command. The Jedi Master has become instrumental in transforming a scattered insurgency into a capable military force. His decades of battlefield experience make Kota one of the Alliance's most respected commanders and a natural choice to mentor the next generation of Jedi.

Rahm Kota commands the Redeemer, an upgraded Venator-class Star Destroyer. His flagship boasts a top-of-the-line reactor, allowing for better shielding and explosive acceleration.
